title: Industrialized AI factory infrastructure: Vertiv and Hut 8
summary: Explore how Vertiv and Hut 8 are building repeatable AI factory infrastructure, standardized across campuses and engineered for gigawatt-scale AI capacity.
body_markdown:
### How Vertiv™ OneCore supports AI data center deployment at scale


At Beacon Point, Vertiv and Hut 8 deployed Vertiv™ OneCore to complete more integration, quality assurance, and validation activities before deployment. Completing more work in a controlled manufacturing environment reduces field integration requirements and helps streamline project execution.


The campus provides a pathway to 1 gigawatt (GW) of AI capacity, built to support multiple compute generations.


*Figure 1. Preliminary rendering of Beacon Point Data Center, Hut 8's second AI data center. Source:[Hut8.com](https://www.hut8.com/news-insights/press-releases/hut-8-commercializes-first-phase-of-1-gw-beacon-point-ai-data-center-campus-with-15-year-352-mw)*


**


---


*“At Beacon Point, we are applying Vertiv’s global manufacturing depth, supply chain discipline, engineering expertise, and critical digital infrastructure portfolio to help deliver AI capacity with speed, reliability, and long-term performance.”*


Giordano Albertazzi,


Chief Executive Officer, Hut 8


---


### Orchestrating converged physical infrastructure for the AI era


Bring power, cooling, controls, and services together under a single design intent to reduce deployment complexity at AI data center scale.


Reduce deployment complexity and field integration risk


Improve infrastructure coordination across power, cooling, and controls


Accelerate time to operational readiness


Optimize performance from grid connection through chip-level thermal management and heat-reuse pathway
